title: LSP Readiness Check
summary: Verify code navigation, diagnostics, formatting, and tests before an agent edits your repository.
user: Small product teams onboarding contributors to agent-assisted repositories.
smallest_useful_product: A CLI that inventories repository language tooling, probes commands, and writes an agent-readable signed capability file.
monetization: $49/repository/month for private CI checks, policy templates, and readiness history.
constraints: Run active language-server probes in disposable containers.
